```{python}
import cmcrameri.cm as cmc
import geopandas as gpd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from matplotlib.ticker import FuncFormatter

from rent_project.config import (
    DATA_DIRECTORY,
    OUTPUT_DIRECTORY,
    PROCESSED_DIRECTORY,
)

```

Key bits if analysis:

- Total rent bill
- Maps of totals and change
- Estate regen estimated totals (4 large regenerations)
- Average listings in proximity of crossrail stations
- Regress rent increases on Census characteristics (race, class as a minimum)

# Regional totals time series (ONS/MHCLG data)

```{python}
df = pd.DataFrame({
    "year": [2006, 2011, 2016, 2021, 2025],
    "prs_dwellings": [661779, 872298, 1014230, 1074736, 1121903],
    "rent_nominal": [1216, 1367, 1655, 1735, 2235],
    "cpi_index": [0.5773, 0.6749, 0.7276, 0.8064, 1.0000],
    "hourly_pay": [13.88, 15.84, 16.43, 19.3, 23.69],
})

PAY_2025 = df["hourly_pay"].iloc[-1]  # £23.69 an hour

# Average monthly rent, measured three ways
df["rent_2025"] = df["rent_nominal"] / df["cpi_index"]        # £ at 2025 prices
df["rent_hours"] = df["rent_nominal"] / df["hourly_pay"]      # hours of median-pay work per month's rent
df["rent_hours_scaled"] = df["rent_hours"] * PAY_2025         # hours translated to 2025 pay (for plotting)

# Total annual rent bill = homes x monthly rent x 12
df["total_nominal"] = df["prs_dwellings"] * df["rent_nominal"] * 12
df["total_2025"] = df["prs_dwellings"] * df["rent_2025"] * 12
df["total_hours"] = df["prs_dwellings"] * df["rent_hours"] * 12

d = df.set_index("year")
x = d["prs_dwellings"]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 7))
ax.set_xlim(540000, 1220000)
ax.set_ylim(1100, 2600)

# Isolines
xs = np.linspace(540000, 1220000, 200)
for bn in [10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35]:
    ax.plot(xs, bn * 1e9 / (12 * xs), color="0.8", lw=0.8, ls="--", zorder=0)
    x_lab = max(bn * 1e9 / (12 * 2550), 540000)
    ax.text(x_lab, bn * 1e9 / (12 * x_lab), f" £{bn}bn/yr", color="0.55", fontsize=8, va="top")

# Lines and dots
for col, name, color, offset in [("rent_nominal", "£ nominal", "C0", 0),
                            ("rent_2025", "£ 2025 prices", "C1", 10),
                            ("rent_hours_scaled", "work hours\n(median pay)", "C2", -10)]:
    ax.plot(x, d[col], color=color, lw=2.5, solid_joinstyle="round", solid_capstyle="round")
    ax.scatter(x, d[col], color=color, s=40, edgecolor="white", zorder=3)
    ax.annotate(name, (x[2006], d.loc[2006, col]), xytext=(-50, offset), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", va="center", color=color)

# Label displacement from its own dot, per year and series: (dx, dy) in points; (0, 0) = on the dot
LABEL_YEARS = {
    2006: {"rent_nominal": (10, -20), "rent_2025": (10, 20), "rent_hours_scaled": (10, -20)},
    2011: {"rent_nominal": (0, -20), "rent_2025": (0, -20), "rent_hours_scaled": (-10, 20)},
    2016: {"rent_nominal": (0, -20), "rent_2025": (0, -20), "rent_hours_scaled": (0, 20)},
    2021: {"rent_nominal": (0, -20), "rent_2025": (0, 35), "rent_hours_scaled": (0, -20)},
    2025: {"rent_nominal": (30, -30), "rent_2025": (30, 30), "rent_hours_scaled": (30, 0)},
}

for year, offset in LABEL_YEARS.items():
    r = d.loc[year]
    ax.annotate(f"{year}\n£{r['total_nominal'] / 1e9:.1f}bn", (x[year], r["rent_nominal"]), xytext=offset["rent_nominal"],
                textcoords="offset points", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9, color="C0")
    ax.annotate(f"{year}\n£{r['total_2025'] / 1e9:.1f}bn", (x[year], r["rent_2025"]), xytext=offset["rent_2025"],
                textcoords="offset points", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9, color="C1")
    ax.annotate(f"{year}\n{r['total_hours'] / 1e9:.2f}bn hrs", (x[year], r["rent_hours_scaled"]), xytext=offset["rent_hours_scaled"],
                textcoords="offset points", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9, color="C2")

# X axis
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"{v / 1e6:.1f}m"))
ax.set_xlabel("Private rented dwellings in London")

# Left axis
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"£{v:,.0f}"))
ax.set_ylabel("Average monthly rent")

# Right axis: the green line in its own unit
sec = ax.secondary_yaxis("right", functions=(lambda v: v / PAY_2025, lambda v: v * PAY_2025))
sec.set_ylabel("Hours of median-pay work per month's rent", color="C2")

fig.savefig(OUTPUT_DIRECTORY / "total_rent_bill", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
plt.show()

```

# Maps

## Data Prep

```{python}
points = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
    data,
    geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(data["x_coordinate"], data["y_coordinate"]),
    crs="EPSG:27700",
)
boroughs = gpd.read_file(
    DATA_DIRECTORY / "raw" / "spatial-boundaries" / "london-boroughs" / "london-boroughs-clipped.gpkg"
    ).to_crs("EPSG:27700")
london = boroughs.union_all()



hexagons = gpd.read_file(
    DATA_DIRECTORY / "raw" / "spatial-boundaries" / "hex-grid-1075m" / "hex-grid-1075.shp"
    ).to_crs("EPSG:27700")

joined = gpd.sjoin(points, hexagons[["geometry"]], predicate="within")

# Rent only counts towards the total for privately rented properties
joined["rent_2011"] = joined["est_rent_2011"].where(joined["private_rented_2011"], 0)
joined["rent_2021"] = joined["est_rent_2021"].where(joined["private_rented_2021"], 0)

stats = joined.groupby("index_right").agg(
    n_properties=("uprn", "size"),
    n_private_rented_2011=("private_rented_2011", "sum"),
    n_private_rented_2021=("private_rented_2021", "sum"),
    t_rent_2011=("rent_2011", "sum"),
    t_rent_2021=("rent_2021", "sum"),
)
# average rents
stats["a_rent_2011"] = stats["t_rent_2011"] / stats["n_private_rented_2011"]
stats["a_rent_2021"] = stats["t_rent_2021"] / stats["n_private_rented_2021"]
# change over time
stats["n_private_rented_change_relative"] = (stats["n_private_rented_2021"] / stats["n_private_rented_2011"] - 1)*100
stats["n_private_rented_change_absolute"] = stats["n_private_rented_2021"] - stats["n_private_rented_2011"]
stats["t_rent_change_relative"] = (stats["t_rent_2021"] / stats["t_rent_2011"] - 1)*100
stats["t_rent_change_absolute"] = stats["t_rent_2021"] - stats["t_rent_2011"]
stats["a_rent_change_relative"] = (stats["a_rent_2021"] / stats["a_rent_2011"] - 1)*100
stats["a_rent_change_absolute"] = stats["a_rent_2021"] - stats["a_rent_2011"]

hexagons = hexagons.join(stats)  # hexagons with no properties get NaN
hexagons = hexagons.clip(london, keep_geom_type=True)

```

# Map function

```{python}
def plot_hex_map(
    column,
    formatter,
    vmin=None,
    vmax=None,
    extend="both",
    filename=None,
    cmap=cmc.batlow,
):
    """Plot a hexagon choropleth with borough outlines and a colour-matched histogram.

    vmin / vmax default to the 5th / 95th percentile of the column.
    If filename is given, the figure is saved to OUTPUT_DIRECTORY.
    """
    data = hexagons[column].dropna()
    if vmin is None:
        vmin = data.quantile(0.05)
    if vmax is None:
        vmax = data.quantile(0.95)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 9))

    # map
    hexagons.drop(data.index).plot(ax=ax, color="#e6e6e6", linewidth=0, zorder=0)
    hexagons.loc[data.index].plot(
        column=column,
        cmap=cmap,
        vmin=vmin,
        vmax=vmax,
        legend=True,
        legend_kwds={"shrink": 0.6, "extend": extend, "format": formatter},
        ax=ax,
    )

    # boroughs
    boroughs.boundary.plot(ax=ax, color="white", linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.8, zorder=3)

    ax.set_axis_off()
    plt.tight_layout()
    fig.canvas.draw()

    # histogram
    cbar_pos = fig.axes[1].get_position()
    width = 0.12
    height = cbar_pos.height * 0.3
    gap = 0.02

    hist_ax = fig.add_axes([cbar_pos.x0 - gap - width, cbar_pos.y0, width, height])
    n, bins, patches = hist_ax.hist(data.clip(lower=vmin, upper=vmax), bins=15)

    for patch in patches:
        mid = patch.get_x() + patch.get_width() / 2
        patch.set_facecolor(cmap((mid - vmin) / (vmax - vmin)))

    hist_ax.set_axis_off()

    if filename:
        fig.savefig(OUTPUT_DIRECTORY / filename, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
    plt.show()
```

# Plotting and saving maps

```{python}

mils = FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"£{x / 1e6:g}m")
mils_change = FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"{'-' if x < 0 else '+'}£{abs(x) / 1e6:g}m")
pct_change = FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"{x:+g}%")
properties = FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"{x:+,.0f}")
rent = FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"£{x:+,.0f}")

# 2011 and 2021 totals
rent_vmax = max(hexagons[c].dropna().quantile(0.95) for c in ["t_rent_2011", "t_rent_2021"])

plot_hex_map(
    "t_rent_2011",
    mils,
    vmin=0, vmax=rent_vmax, extend="max",
    filename="01_total-rent-2011.png",
)
plot_hex_map(
    "t_rent_2021",
    mils,
    vmin=0, vmax=rent_vmax, extend="max",
    filename="02_total-rent-2021.png",
)

# change in rent totals (absolute)
plot_hex_map(
    "t_rent_change_absolute",
    mils_change,
#    filename="03_total-rent-change-absolute.png",
)

# change in rent totals (relative)
plot_hex_map(
    "t_rent_change_relative",
    pct_change,
#    filename="04_total-rent-change-relative.png"
)

# change in number of private rented properties (absolute)
plot_hex_map(
    "n_private_rented_change_absolute",
    properties,
#    filename="05_number-private-rented-change-absolute.png",
)

# change in number of private rented properties (relative)
plot_hex_map(
    "n_private_rented_change_relative",
    pct_change,
#    filename="06_number-private-rented-change-relative.png",
)

# change in average rent (absolute)
plot_hex_map(
    "a_rent_change_absolute",
    rent,
#    filename="07_average-rent-change-absolute.png",
)

# change in average rent (relative)
plot_hex_map(
    "a_rent_change_relative",
    pct_change,
#    filename="08_average-rent-change-relative.png",
)
```

```{python}
# to-do:

estates = gpd.read_file(
    DATA_DIRECTORY / "my-gis" / "my-layers" / "large-regenerations.shp"
    ).to_crs("EPSG:27700")
joined_estates = gpd.sjoin(points, estates[["name","geometry"]], predicate="within")

# Rent only counts towards the total for privately rented properties
joined_estates["rent_2021"] = joined_estates["est_rent_2021"].where(joined_estates["private_rented_2021"], 0)

stats_estates = joined_estates.groupby("name").agg(
    n_properties=("uprn", "size"),
    n_residential_2021=("is_residential_2021", "sum"),
    n_private_rented_2021=("private_rented_2021", "sum"),
    t_rent_2021=("rent_2021", "sum"),
)
stats_estates["pct_private_rented_2021"] = stats_estates["n_private_rented_2021"] / stats_estates["n_residential_2021"]
stats_estates["a_rent_2021"] = stats_estates["t_rent_2021"] / stats_estates["n_private_rented_2021"]

stats_estates["t_rent_2021"]["Ocean Estate"]   # £ 25,475,358
stats_estates["t_rent_2021"]["Ferrier Estate"] # £ 14,928,120
```

# Crossrail

```{python}
# points
crossrail = gpd.read_file(
    DATA_DIRECTORY / "my-gis" / "my-layers" / "crossrail-distance-rings-no-overlaps-04.shp"
    ).to_crs("EPSG:27700")
joined_crossrail = gpd.sjoin(points, crossrail[["label","geometry"]], predicate="within")

rent_cols = joined_crossrail.filter(regex=r"^listed_rent_\d{4}$").columns

stats_crossrail = joined_crossrail.groupby("label")[rent_cols].mean()
stats_crossrail.columns = stats_crossrail.columns.str[-4:].astype(int)  # "listed_rent_2014" -> 2014

indexed = stats_crossrail
indexed = stats_crossrail.div(stats_crossrail[2014], axis=0)

ax = indexed.T.plot(marker="o", figsize=(9, 5))
ax.axhline(1, color="grey", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--")
ax.set_xlabel("Year")
ax.set_ylabel("Average listed rent (2014 = 1)")
ax.set_title("Rental listing value by ring, indexed to 2014")
ax.legend(title="Ring")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

```
